join hortbot 999 foobar 1


handle hortbot foobar/1 random/2 :!var
no_send

handle hortbot foobar/1 random/2 access=subscriber :!var
no_send


handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!var
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Usage: !var set|get|delete|increment|decrement

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!var what
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Usage: !var set|get|delete|increment|decrement


handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!var get
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Usage: !var get <name>

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!var set
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Usage: !var set <name> <value>


handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!var get what
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Variable what does not exist.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!var set what Hello there.
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Variable what set to: Hello there.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!var get what
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Variable what is set to: Hello there.


handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!var delete
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Usage: !var delete <name>

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!var remove
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Usage: !var remove <name>

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!var delete what
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Variable what has been deleted.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!var remove what
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Variable what has been deleted.


handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!var increment
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Usage: !var increment <name> <value>

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!var decrement
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Usage: !var decrement <name> <value>


handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!var increment what huh
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Usage: !var increment <name> <value>

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!var decrement what huh
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Usage: !var decrement <name> <value>


handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!var increment what 1
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Variable what has been incremented to 1.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!var increment what 2
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Variable what has been incremented to 3.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!var decrement what 4
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Variable what has been decremented to -1.


handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!var set what Hello there.
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Variable what set to: Hello there.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!var increment what 2
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Variable what is not an integer.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!var decrement what 4
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Variable what is not an integer.
